This looks like die-back — a condition where shoots and branches die from the tip backward, resulting in complete leaf death and browning.

Now let me view one reference image from Die_Back to confirm.

The Die_Back reference image is a near-perfect match: completely brown/dead leaf, same elongated narrow mango leaf shape, same degree of desiccation and twisting, same uniform dark brown coloration with no green remaining, same white background. The test image aligns strongly with Die_Back.
